meta.primary_actor: Software Developer / CTO / Technical Lead evaluating Spanish invoicing & VeriFactu REST API integration

workflow_and_architecture.workflow_trigger: Developer arrives looking to integrate automated Spanish invoicing, VeriFactu compliance, and expense syncing into their SaaS/ERP/CRM.
user_decision_journey: 1. Verify developer ergonomic quality & real-world request/response shape in Hero (curl/fetch live interactive terminal).
2. Explore API capabilities across 6 core endpoints (Empresas, Clientes, Facturas, PDF, VeriFactu, Gastos) with immediate interactive endpoint inspector.
3. Understand architecture pillars: multi-tenant company isolation, HMAC-SHA256 signed webhooks with live interactive delivery trace simulation, and request audit logging.
4. Compare plans with transparent limits (Platino 24,99€/mes 60 req/min vs Multiempresas 49,99€/mes 120 req/min).
5. Resolve compliance & integration questions in interactive FAQ accordion.
6. Convert via primary CTA ('Empieza gratis' 14-day trial) or navigate to Swagger docs ('/api/v1/docs').

workspace_layout.type: Focused Developer Landing Page (Single Page App with high-impact dark slate aesthetic matching OpenFactura home API section)
workspace_layout.alternative_evaluated: Light SaaS landing page identical to Pos/billing pages
workspace_layout.tradeoff_rationale: Developer marketing standard (Stripe, Resend, Clerk) favors dark void/slate backgrounds with high-contrast syntax highlighting, vibrant #0052FF glows, and live terminals. OpenFactura's home page already features dark slate-950 for its API section; bringing this dark-mode developer experience to /para-desarrolladores creates instant credibility, cohesive brand authority, and developer delight.
workspace_layout.mobile_adaptation: Two-column grids collapse to stacked single-column; terminal tabs switch horizontally with smooth swipe; sticky topbar retains quick docs and start buttons; webhook event pills wrap cleanly with tap-to-inspect modal.

items.a: Platino y Multiempresas. Las gestorías también pueden crear claves para las empresas de sus clientes.
Con una clave de API en la cabecera Authorization: Bearer of_live_... Cada clave pertenece a una sola empresa y puede ser de solo lectura o de lectura y escritura.
Sí. Las facturas emitidas por la API siguen el mismo proceso que en la app: huella encadenada, QR y envío a la AEAT con el certificado de la empresa.

items.q: ¿Dónde veo lo que hace mi sistema?
items.a: En el panel «API» de tu cuenta verás cada petición, su resultado, los avisos (webhooks) enviados y el estado de la conexión.
